title: LLM for Everyone: Representing the Underrepresented in Large Language Models
findings: The paper's UniVaR value map demonstrates that LLMs cluster languages based on shared cultural and religious values. For example, Indonesian, Malaysian, and Arabic languages cluster together, reflecting shared Islamic values, while Chinese, Japanese, and Korean cluster together, reflecting shared Confucian and Buddhist values. This indicates that LLMs' internal value representations capture these religio-cultural similarities.
